A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work and provide readable text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices. Content can be reliably matched across the substantial reorganization.

before.justification: v2 reports original token-alignment measurements, spectral interventions, sparse-retrieval evaluations, and linguistic and instruction-following case studies.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results in its main text and reorganized appendices.

M1.justification: Decoder projection, token ranking, principal-component adjustment, document sparsification, and query expansion are unchanged. Process 1 now explicitly selects the top K tokens, but this operation was already specified in v2 Section 3.4.

E1.justification: Both use Wikipedia, SNLI, and MSMARCO for alignment analysis; FiQA, NFCorpus, SciFact, and ArguAna for retrieval; and the same linguistic and toy-example scenarios. v3 Appendix G.2 discusses results already present in v2 Figure 4.

E2.justification: The eight embedders and corresponding generative backbones remain unchanged. Table 3 retains BM25, SPLADEv2, and the dense LLM2Vec and GritLM comparisons. The newly cited BeLLM is not evaluated.

E3.justification: Both retain the 10K-document alignment samples, 500 query-document pairs for parent-word analysis, and Hit@10, LAR, GAR, and nDCG@10 metrics. Retrieval instructions, test-set hyperparameter selection, and the K and M search grids are unchanged.

E4.justification: Principal-component interventions, K/M sensitivity experiments, training-data and instruction comparisons, additional token examples, and parent-word analyses are retained. Their relocation and the added explanation in Appendix G.2 do not introduce new analytical experiments.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests, or experimental error bars. The component-variation and hyperparameter plots retain the same reporting practices.

E6.justification: All Table 3 scores match, including sparse FiQA scores of 0.404 for LLM2Vec and 0.457 for GritLM. The empirical plots, aligned-token tables, case-study similarities, and estimated 13.4% FLOPs ratio are also unchanged after matching relocated content.

T1.justification: The mathematical treatment acquires a local inconsistency: v3 Section 3.2 defines E_g as d-by-L and projects with its transpose, but Equation 12 still multiplies E_g directly by d-dimensional vectors. v2's L-by-d definition made corresponding Equation 9 dimensionally compatible. The substantive SVD derivation and metric definitions otherwise remain unchanged.

C1.justification: v3 explicitly presents alignment as a unified perspective on prompt engineering and contrastive learning, refining the first contribution beyond v2's emphasis on an unusual phenomenon. The central alignment, dominant-principal-component, and sparse-retrieval claims remain.

C2.justification: v3 qualifies why alignment is surprising for prompt-based methods and links differences in LAR/GAR across datasets to text length. It removes v2 Section 3.5's whole-space geometric interpretation and changes the traditional-model limitation from an explicit DPR exception to several special cases.

D1.justification: Model checkpoints, access links, retrieval instructions, and implementation disclosures are retained. Both specify Python 3.10, PyTorch 2.3.0, CUDA 12.4, and a single NVIDIA A100 40GB. Moving these details between appendices does not change reproducibility information.

R1.justification: v3 adds Li and Li's BeLLM citation and removes several baseline and backbone references, including BM25 and SPLADEv2 references. It also drops the explicit claim of greater generality than Peng et al. The comparison with Ram et al. is retained in Appendix A.

P1.justification: The narrative is substantially reorganized: quantitative definitions enter Section 3.4, instruction-following becomes Section 5.2, related work moves to Appendix A, and pseudocode moves to Appendix C. The former discussion subsection is removed, appendices are regrouped, and terminology is revised toward 'LLM-based embedder.'

P2.justification: Displays are substantially redistributed: v2 Figure 4 is split into v3 Figures 2 and 7, the instruction-following table moves into the main text, and supplementary spectral and parent-word figures receive separate pages. Figure 1's terminology and several captions change; the empirical graphics themselves are retained.

improvement.justification: Bringing quantitative evidence and the instruction-following demonstration into the main text makes the central argument easier to assess, while the revised introduction better qualifies its novelty. These modest clarity gains outweigh the localized transpose inconsistency and reduced citation detail. The revision does not strengthen the empirical evidence.
